# `Q-9-7` — Missing Required Attribute

> A CSL element is missing an attribute that its schema
> requires.

## What this means

Many CSL elements have required attributes. `<cs:macro>`
requires `name`, `<cs:style>` requires `version`, `<cs:term>`
requires `name`. This error fires when one of those required
attributes is missing. The message names both the element and
the attribute.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A hand-edited CSL style** where the attribute was deleted
  by mistake.
- **A style copied from an incomplete example.**
- **A migration from an older CSL version** where the
  attribute was not yet required.

## How to fix

Add the attribute. The message tells you both which element is
incomplete and which attribute is missing, so the fix is
mechanical. The official CSL specification lists every required
attribute per element.

## Related

- `Q-9-8` — invalid attribute value: the attribute is present
  but its value is wrong.
- `Q-9-9` — missing required element: the same family of
  schema-required-thing-is-missing, but for child elements.
